# The single tool registry. One row per: # Each platform cell is "source:name"; an empty cell means the tool is not
#   brew:     Homebrew formula          (macOS and Linux both — brew runs on Fedora)
#   dnf:      Fedora system package     (only where brew shouldn't own it)
#   mise:     runtime managed by mise   (see config/mise/config.toml)
#   npm:      global npm package        (installed after mise's node is active)
#   nerdfont: Nerd Font release archive (downloaded and unzipped)
#   vscode:   VS Code extension         (skipped when `code` is not on PATH)
# `windows_host` is deliberately sparse: Windows is provisioned as WSL2
# tools live inside the Fedora guest. Only things that must sit on the Windows
# *host* to work at all (fonts and the terminal) get a value here.
# `./install.sh --coverage` reports rows available on macOS but not Fedora (or
# vice versa) so parity gaps stay visible instead of silently drifting.
# Keep notes comma-free — this is parsed with IFS='
